known_issues: Env map: Source uses a per-map env_cubemap; FNV statics use shared cubemaps, so shinydull_e.dds is used. Reflection tint will differ slightly (engine-driven).
Normal map is flat (Source material has no bump/phong). Surface relief is geometric only, as in Source.
Collision convex radius 0.1 Havok units (~0.7 game units) on top of Source's own ~0.4-unit physics padding; expected contact offset ~1 unit.
No vertex colours: Source static-prop lighting is baked per map, not stored in the model. Bench is lit dynamically in FNV.
Seat height ~37 FNV units vs ~32 on vanilla museum bench; credible but Codex should judge it against the player.
Not tested in game yet. Static gates only.
